title: Exact uniformity of Smart quantity under independent lifts (N4)
question: Let E/F_p with p not dividing #E(F_p), fix a lift of the curve mod p^2, and P of order r != p. For independent uniform lifts P~, Q~ (mod p^2) of P and Q = [k]P, the pair (psi(P~), psi(Q~)) is uniform on F_p^2 for every k, where psi(X~) = (-x/y)([#E] X~)/p mod p. For consistent lifts Q~ = [k]P~ one has psi(Q~) = k psi(P~) exactly. Hence psi carries information about k only through the choice of lifts, i.e. only when k is already used.
rationale: Corrected variant produced by the ECDLP-5 counterexample run; recorded separately, original kept.
